title: Youth Cambodia Platform
subtitle: Youth Cambodia Platform
description: A community-driven web platform designed to support and empower youth in Cambodia. It provides access to events, educational resources, volunteer opportunities, and networking spaces.

title: Sys-TopUp Clone
subtitle: Fast and secure game top-up platform
description: A clone of a digital top-up system where users can purchase in-game credits and services. The platform focuses on speed, user-friendly design, and secure transactions.

title: Tour Trips
subtitle: Tour Trips Booking System
description: A travel web application that allows users to explore tour packages, view destinations, and book trips easily. It features destination highlights, pricing details, and booking management.

title: Sabay Tinh
subtitle: A space for sharing feelings and stories
description: A social platform that allows users to express emotions, share personal stories, and connect with others. It promotes positivity, emotional support, and community interaction.

title: Blogfy
subtitle: Modern blogging interface for creators
description: A responsive frontend blogging platform where users can read, write, and explore articles. It focuses on clean design, readability, and smooth user interaction.

title: JobHub
subtitle: Backend service for job matching platforms
description: A backend system that powers a job portal, handling user authentication, job listings, applications, and employer management. It provides RESTful APIs for frontend integration.

title: SAHAKKA
subtitle: Project management system for team collaboration
description: A full-stack project management platform built to improve team productivity through workspace, team, and task management. The system includes authentication, role-based permissions, RESTful API integration, document management, task tracking, feedback, activity logs, and analytics dashboard.
